summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Gorakhai CMS Milestone 2 (Admin CMS). All auth flows, admin CRUD, public routes, and admin UI tested. Found and fixed a critical ObjectId serialization bug in audit-logs endpoint. All 27 backend tests passing, UI working correctly.

bugs_fixed.bug: GET /api/admin/audit-logs returned 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization failure. The _audit() function stored user['_id'] (ObjectId) directly into audit_log documents. When retrieved, FastAPI jsonable_encoder failed to serialize nested ObjectIds in before_state/after_state fields.
bugs_fixed.fix: 1) Changed _audit() to store str(user['_id']) instead of raw ObjectId. 2) Replaced simple _doc() helper with recursive _convert() function that deep-converts all ObjectId instances to strings in nested dicts/lists.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard shows 9 job listings instead of 6 - test data (3 TEST_ jobs) from backend test suite not cleaned up. Consider adding teardown in test suite.
audit-logs endpoint: _audit() in admin_routes.py had ObjectId stored as-is - now fixed with recursive _convert(). Same pattern should be checked in public_routes.py if _audit is called there too.

Login error message not shown in UI when wrong password entered - error element exists (data-testid='login-error') but CSS selector '.error' not matching. This may be due to error styling using different class names (bg-red-500/10). Actually it IS working since the error div shows conditionally - test scripts using .error class selector won't find it. The login error IS displayed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (27/27 passed, 1 skipped - experts approve skipped as no applications exist)

seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ career listings and 3 contact leads created during backend testing (not cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CMS features working: auth (login/logout/me), dashboard stats, blog CRUD, careers CRUD, leads management, newsletter, waitlist, experts (no applications yet), audit logs (fixed ObjectId bug), activity logs, all public routes. Admin UI: login page, dashboard with stats, blog table (6 posts), new blog post editor, careers table (9 listings after test data), new career form all working. Sidebar shows: Dashboard, Blog, Careers, Leads, Newsletter, Waitlist, Expert Applications, Admin Users, Activity Logs + Coming Soon: AI Boardroom, Expert Marketplace, Community, Events, Partner Program.
rca_of_issues: Audit-logs 500: _audit() in admin_routes.py line 43 stored user['_id'] as raw ObjectId in MongoDB document. On read, _doc() only stripped top-level _id but left nested ObjectIds. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder tried to serialize ObjectId and failed. Fix: (1) store str(user['_id']) at write time, (2) add recursive _convert() to handle any remaining nested ObjectIds in before_state/after_state snapshots.
